Source Bigg Boss contestant ScoutOP has emerged as a strong contender and has been trending on social media. Last weekend, ScoutOP’s girlfriend, Kaashvi Hiranandani, confronted him over his closeness to fellow contestant Lovepreet Kaur.
 During the confrontation, Kaashvi questioned Scout about his interactions with Love, asking, "How is the massage parlour going, Tanmay?" She also turned to Love and questioned her behavior toward Scout, asking, "Do you also behave like that with your brothers?" Love defended her actions, saying, "It felt normal to me because I was in pain."
 Following that episode, ScoutOP has been trying to change his strategy to win back his girlfriend and appease the viewers. Rumors suggest that the show's makers plan to focus on ScoutOP and Lovepreet’s bond again this upcoming weekend. Viewers who caught wind of this claim the makers are deliberately targeting ScoutOP.
 One social media user commented, "And I’m pretty sure Scout OP will be targeted yet again this WKV. The makers’ bias is getting way too predictable now."
 Another user noted, "ScoutOP is heading in the wrong direction. The makers wanted to make him out to be a villain, and he has completely lost the plot now. Charging at girls looks very weak. That breakup line about Uditi was way too disappointing. No support for him now."
